note: Where the outline is wrong and a human is right. A 50 m coastline rounded to three decimals cannot resolve a border that runs three kilometres from a village, so a handful of places need saying out loud. Keyed by place id, and every entry must carry a reason — an override with no reason is indistinguishable from a typo.

vitaljina.why: Croatia's southernmost settlement, in Konavle. The Montenegrin border is 3 km away and the rounded outline puts the point on the wrong side of it.
